1_mock_ui: UI exists but is static, mocked, or not wired to canonical data.
2_partial_data: Some data exists, but source of truth, validation, permissions, or reports are incomplete.
3_working_vertical_slice: Database/API/frontend work end-to-end for core use cases.
4_governed_module: Permissions, audit logs, workflows, tests, and reports are complete.
5_configurable_saas_ready: Tenant-configurable, secure, tested, observable, and ready for external SaaS tenants.
